name: @nestjs/mongoose
description: @nestjs/mongoose 10/11 over xisto's mongoose (stage 1, no driver yet): @Schema/@Prop/SchemaFactory, MongooseModule.forRoot/forRootAsync/forFeature/forFeatureAsync, @InjectModel/@InjectConnection, getModelToken/getConnectionToken. A module that is never imported registers nothing (an @Optional() model is null); a registered forRoot connection fails the application's start with 'mongoose: no MongoDB driver in xisto yet (stage 2)'.
